ValidationRule.description: Regulated projects must have a location within 3000 miles of the (37.7749, -122.4194) reference point.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Regulated'), NOT(ISBLANK(Location__latitude__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(Location__longitude__s)), DISTANCE(Location__c, GEOLOCATION(37.7749, -122.4194), 'mi') > 3000 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Regulated projects must be located within 3000 miles of the reference HQ.
